question.text: Minimum investment in an AIF (regulatory) per investor:

explanation.text: The Logic: The SEBI AIF framework prescribes a minimum investment of Rs. 1 crore per investor for AIFs, as supported by the cited workbook page. The Trap: Rs. 5 lakh, Rs. 25 lakh, and Rs. 5 crore each misstate the regulatory minimum and tempt candidates who confuse AIF rules with thresholds applicable to other product categories. Note: Only the Rs. 1 crore minimum is anchored to the page checked; any further employee/director carve-outs require a separately cited regulatory source.
